mapper.sql: id, device_id, channel_no, property_id, value_type, value_num, value_text, value_json::text as value_json, value_time, updated_at
mapper.select: select from pep_domain.device_property_latest where device_id = #{deviceId} order by channel_no, property_id
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.device_property_latest (device_id, channel_no, property_id, value_type, value_num, value_text, value_json, value_time, updated_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{channelNo}, #{propertyId}, #{valueType}, #{valueNum}, #{valueText}, cast(#{valueJson} as jsonb), #{valueTime}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update pep_domain.device_property_latest set device_id = #{deviceId}, channel_no = #{channelNo}, property_id = #{propertyId}, value_type = #{valueType}, value_num = #{valueNum}, value_text = #{valueText}, value_json = cast(#{valueJson} as jsonb), value_time = #{valueTime}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
